description: Source code for a Zep vector store component implementing vector store operations, including upsert and similarity search, for integration with a larger LLM application framework.

classes.name: Zep_VectorStores
classes.description: Implements a vector store node for Zep, supporting upsert and initialization, with configuration for collection and metadata filtering.

classes.name: ZepExistingVS
classes.description: Extends ZepVectorStore to handle existing collections, including collection initialization, creation, and similarity search with filtering.

methods.name: vectorStoreMethods.upsert
methods.description: Asynchronously upserts documents into the Zep collection, converting documents and configuring the Zep vector store.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Zep vector store with provided configuration, including collection and filter setup.

methods.name: zepDocsToDocumentsAndScore
methods.description: Converts IDocument results to Document objects with associated scores.

methods.name: assignMetadata
methods.description: Assigns metadata to documents, ensuring proper object format.

methods.name: ZepExistingVS.initializeCollection
methods.description: Initializes the collection, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: ZepExistingVS.createNewCollection
methods.description: Creates a new collection with specified parameters.

methods.name: ZepExistingVS.similaritySearchVectorWithScore
methods.description: Performs a similarity search with vector query and optional filtering, returning documents with scores.

methods.name: ZepExistingVS.fromExistingIndex
methods.description: Creates an instance of ZepExistingVS from an existing index configuration.
